items.name: IEEE Cubing Nepal 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTU1MDMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--cd5fab2f0a9583192266fe07fa93f6ca1fd38306/IEEE-CS.png)


**IEEE Cubing Nepal 2025** is organized in coordination with the **IEEE Computer Society Pulchowk Student Branch Chapter**. This Rubik’s Cube competition welcomes cubers from all around the world to participate, compete, and celebrate their passion for cubing.

For more updates on events and activities by the Computer Society Chapter, check out [Pulchowk Computer Society on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/pulchowkcompsbc/).

Please take a look at the other tabs for more details. You can [contact](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IEEECubingNepal2025#60043-contact-info) us for any queries.

**First-time participants must bring an ID card with their Date of Birth for identity verification.**

**Participants are requested to arrive at least 15 minutes before the end of the scheduled registration time to ensure timely procedures.**

items.information:
This competition is the third iteration of **Nepal Open (Nepali National Championship)** and is open to competitors of all nationalities. However,  only **Nepalese participants** will be eligible for prizes and titles. 

यो प्रतियोगिता नेपाल ओपन (नेपाली राष्ट्रिय प्रतिस्पर्धा)को तेस्रो शृङ्खला हो र यो सबै राष्ट्रियताको प्रतियोगीका लागि खुला छ। तर उपाधि तथा पुरस्कार प्राप्त गर्न नेपाली प्रतियोगी मात्रै योग्य हुने छन्।



Pre-registration on the WCA website is compulsory. All participants wishing to compete will have to register through this [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/register). 

डब्लूसीएको औपचारिक वेबसाइटमा अग्रिम दर्ता गर्न अनिवार्य रहेको छ। सहभागी हुन इच्छुक महानुभावहरूले यस [लिङ्कबाट](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018/registe)दर्ता गर्नु होस् ।



Please make sure to check the [Travel](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7837-travel) and [Accomodation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NepalOpen2018#7836-accommodation) tabs.

items.information:
Nepal Open 2016 is open to citizens of all countries, but only Nepali participants can win prizes and titles.
The venue is located in SOS Children's Village Kavre, opposite to Kathmandu University and about 26km from the central region of Capital Kathmandu. Seat Limit is 80, register fast, registration fee is NRs 250 ($2.5) for 3x3 then for all other events it's NRs 60,($0.6).
As the first official speedcubing competition in Nepal, here it comes!
